scope: New actual staging main-process named singleton payload observations; not physical savings or full P011 acceptance

runtime.httpWorkerAttribution: unknown; requests can reach sibling workers
runtime.fullLoadedSourceIdentity: unknown; health-reported build and disk bundle identity have separate meanings

sourceHashQualification: Hashes were measured after the run. They are current named file identities, not an assertion of a complete frozen executed-source graph.

metricDefinitions.pssBytes: Kernel smaps_rollup Pss kilobytes times 1024; main process only
metricDefinitions.stringCodeUnits: Length summed over observed string references, including map keys; repeated strings can share physical storage
metricDefinitions.byteViewExtents: Summed observed view byte lengths; views can overlap backing stores
metricDefinitions.arrayBufferExtents: Observed ArrayBuffer byte lengths; can overlap the storage counted through views
metricDefinitions.mapEntries: Total builtin Map size summed for the maps actually reached before limits
metricDefinitions.rootOwner: Named global singleton root reachable from module-singleton.slots; shared objects are counted at their first observed root
metricDefinitions.zeroWithTraversalLimited: Not inspected; never evidence that the root is empty
metricDefinitions.observerMs: In-target wall time including V8 property key enumeration; a budget check is not a hard latency ceiling

remaining: The global entry/time budget is consumed early in registry order. Later named caches report traversalLimited; their zero payload counters do not measure emptiness.
Add a fair per-root or explicitly targeted inspection guard before attempting dispositions for uninspected roots.
Symbols, non-enumerable properties, function closures, unpinned roots and native owners remain outside this inventory.
No retained heap byte attribution, paired intervention, useful-context/concurrency comparison, independent R8/R9 acceptance or final shipment is established.
